dashboard_trackers.notes: No fresh Line of Control exchange, Indian force movement, or India-Pakistan strike was verified. Search spillover was dominated by unrelated Gulf and Pakistan domestic-security coverage. Raw/coupled 15

dashboard_trackers.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: The Tank district mass-casualty attack remains a Pakistan counter-insurgency event. Taliban officials rejected Pakistani blame, but no fresh state-on-state border strike, sustained clash, or retaliation was verified. Raw/coupled 46

dashboard_trackers.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: No new Taiwan quarantine, blockade declaration, amphibious mobilization, or military clash surfaced. A July 24 analytical update did not establish a new operational threshold. Raw 24; North Korea coupling +4 => 28

dashboard_trackers.notes: El-Obeid drone attacks and the resulting water/fuel crisis remain active, but no new strategic advance around El-Obeid, el-Fasher, or Port Sudan surfaced after 00Z. Raw/coupled 92

dashboard_trackers.notes: AP, BBC and CBC continue to report the northern West Bank lockdown and Nablus deployment after four Palestinians and two Israelis were killed. No distinct additional strategic threshold was independently verified after 00Z. Raw/coupled 95

dashboard_trackers.notes: Mali remains open to possible U.S. help, but no U.S. strike order, deployment, basing decision, or new JNIM strategic seizure was verified. Raw/coupled 36
